questions.question: Approximately how many passengers does the ferry hold?

analyses.content: 录音中明确提到渡轮可以容纳大约两千人（two thousand people），直接对应选项C的数值。
你可能会听到干扰数字160和600，但这分别是船员（crew）和汽车（cars）的数量，听题时一定要扣准题目问的是乘客（people）。

Now, the ferry crossing from England to Santander in Spain takes about twenty-four hours. We'll be sailing on the Prince Regent, which was first launched in the 1980s. As well as the crew of one hundred and sixty, it can accommodate about two thousand people and six hundred cars, and it sails at an average speed of thirty-seven kilometers an hour.

questions.question: Which items should the tourists pack in a separate bag?

analyses.content: 录音建议把洗漱用品、书和杂志（books and magazines）放在单独的包里，也就是选项B所说的阅读材料（reading material）。
你可能会想选A（食物）或C（药品），但录音明确说明船上会供餐不需要带零食，并且如果不舒服可以找向导拿药，这就排除了这两个干扰项。

Although our minibus will be on one of the vehicle decks in the boat, access to these decks is prohibited during the crossing, so when you leave our bus, you'll have to take everything that you're likely to need with you, like toiletries or books and magazines. In fact, it's probably a good idea to put these things in a separate bag beforehand. You shouldn't need snacks on board as meals are provided, and they're quite substantial. And if you don't feel well or get a headache, you can get tablets from me.

questions.question: The hostel in La Vega de Liébana has

analyses.content: 录音提到浴室和淋浴（bathrooms and showers）有很高的标准，意思完全等同于选项A的良好洗浴设施（good washing facilities）。
你可能会被“game”或“room”干扰，但录音说网球场是在附近（nearby）而不是旅舍内部，且房间是4到8人的合住房间，并非单人间（single bedroom）。

The hostel accommodation's fairly simple. There are bunk beds, and each room holds four to eight people. But the bathrooms and showers are of a high standard. The hostel residents have the use of tennis courts nearby if you feel like a game.

questions.question: Residents at the hostel are not allowed to

analyses.content: 录音最后提到为了不打扰别人休息，午夜后门会被锁上（doors are locked after midnight），这意味着超过特定时间就无法进入旅舍，对应选项B。
你可能会听到smoking和take outside，但录音说的是禁止在室内（inside）抽烟而非花园里，并且允许把家具拿出室外只要晚上归还即可，以此排除A和C。

In general, the hostel is relaxed, but there are a few rules which the owners enforce strictly. Smoking is not allowed anywhere inside the building, and food and drink is banned in the dormitories. Any chairs or tables which you take outside into the gardens must be returned every evening to their original place. Uh, and finally, the doors are locked after midnight out of consideration for other guests who are trying to sleep.

Clothes and equipment
Bring:
• boots with thick soles
• spare
• light waterproofs
• Sun cream: strength
• a folder for map, etc.

analyses.content: 录音在详细讲完关于带厚底鞋的建议后，直接用“It's important to bring spare socks”给出了答案，原词填入socks即可。
你可能会因为前面关于鞋子（boots/trainers）的长篇大论而走神，导致漏听了紧跟在话题末尾出现的填空词。

First, boots. Make sure that the ones you bring have thick soles. That's the most important thing. Don't bring trainers for walking in. Apart from anything else, they're dangerous because they slip. It's important to bring spare socks.
听到防晒霜（sun cream）和强度（strength）的提示词后，录音明确要求买一种叫做“total block”（全面防晒）的类型，直接填入即可。
你可能会习惯性地填入后面紧接着出现的数字“twenty-five”，但录音马上补充说25倍的防晒霜在这个纬度不够用（isn't good enough），属于典型的否定干扰。
Next, sun cream. This is absolutely essential. And regarding the strength, make sure you get what's known as total block. Even factor twenty-five isn't good enough for those latitudes in July.
录音提到带一个活页夹（folder）装地图，随后紧接着补充说是塑料的那种（plastic ones），填入修饰词plastic。
这句话的补充说明非常紧凑，你可能会因为只听到了定位词folder，而忽略了后面独立成句的具体材质描述。
Bring a folder to keep your map and other papers in. You know, one of those plastic ones. It's not very likely to rain, but if it does, [laughs] you'll find it soaks everything.

questions.question: Which THREE of the following features of the area in Spain does the speaker talk about?

analyses.content: 录音中提到最高峰高达两千六百多米（two thousand six hundred meters high），这直接对应了选项A提到的海拔（altitude）。
录音虽然提到了距离海边25公里（from the sea），但这只是一个距离方位描述，并没有讨论具体的海岸线（coastline）特征，听题时不要过度联想。

Now let me tell you a little bit about the area in Spain where we'll be walking, the Picos de Europa. It's a very popular area for tourists because of its spectacular peaks. Although they're only twenty-five kilometers from the sea, the highest peaks are more than two thousand six hundred meters high and have year-round snow caps.

questions.question: Which THREE of the following features of the area in Spain does the speaker talk about?

analyses.content: 录音中连续列举了高山植物（alpine plants）和野花（wildflowers），这些都是对选项E植被（vegetation）的具体举例说明。
多选题容易犯的错误是，听到一堆具体的植物类别名称时没有立刻反应过来它们统属于“植被”这一大类，从而遗漏了该选项。
On the highest peaks, you've got alpine plants that are only free of their snow cover for a few months a year. Then you've got meadows that are full of wildflowers at certain times of the year.

analyses.content: 录音中明确提到该地区的林地是狼和熊等稀有物种（wolves and bears）的栖息地，直接对应选项F的野生动物（wildlife）。
你可能会在录音即将结束时注意力涣散，或者因为不熟悉species（物种）这个前置词，导致把列举出的具体动物当成无关的背景信息过滤掉。
